now.title: Ironheart#4
now.text: Madeline Stanton is Ronnie's friend, and they talk about how Riri is coping with grief.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Madeline's friend, Riri's mother, with whom she talks about Riri's grief.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Ronnie's friend, who talks with her about Riri's grief.

changes.evidence: The talk about Riri's grief is in Ironheart episode 1 'Take Me Home': Ronnie talks to her friends about Riri, and Madeline suspects the deaths of Natalie and Gary still haunt her. In episode 4 'Bad Magic' Ronnie instead brings Riri to Madeline about the Hood's cloak fragment. The friendship and grief talk first hold at #1.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#20
now.text: Piper and Yo-Yo keep Zephyr One flying while the team is trapped in the Framework, arguing over whether to risk dropping the cloak to refuel.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Friend Yo-Yo keeps Zephyr One flying with while the team is in the Framework.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who keeps Zephyr One flying with Piper while the team is trapped.

proposed.text: Piper and Yo-Yo keep Zephyr One flying while the team is trapped in the Framework. When the plane runs low on power, Piper suggests dropping the cloak, and Yo-Yo goes along with it.

changes.evidence: In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4E20 'Farewell, Cruel World!' Piper suggests turning off the cloak to keep the Framework powered; Prince (Davis on the character page) objects, and Yo-Yo decides to follow Piper's suggestion. Piper and Yo-Yo do not argue, and the cloak is dropped to save power, not to refuel (Piper refuses Davis's idea of landing to refuel).

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#9
now.text: Gargan leads the Scorpions against the 110th Street Gang and stabs Lonnie when he shields Big Donovan. Lonnie later fights him beside Spider-Man, then stops Spider-Man from killing him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A rival gangster who stands against Gargan.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The rival gang boss who stabbed Lonnie.

proposed.text: Gargan leads the Scorpions against the 110th Street Gang and tries to impale Lonnie with his tail. Lonnie, newly super strong, fights him beside Spider-Man, then stops Spider-Man from killing him.

changes.evidence: Lonnie shielding Big Donovan from Gargan happens in episode 5 'The Unicorn Unleashed!' (already stage 0). In episode 9 'Hero or Menace' Big Donovan runs away from the brawl; Gargan tries to impale Lonnie with his tail, Lonnie (powered by Diox-3) catches it, fights Gargan with Spider-Man, and stops Spider-Man from impaling Gargan.

now.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
now.text: Jim Morita is freed from a HYDRA prison camp by Steve Rogers and joins the Howling Commandos under his command. He fights with Steve across Europe until the war's end.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Morita's commander, who frees him from a HYDRA camp.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Howling Commando Steve frees from a HYDRA camp.

proposed.text: Jim Morita is freed from a HYDRA prison camp by Steve Rogers and joins the Howling Commandos under his command. He fights with Steve across Europe until Steve goes into the ice.

changes.evidence: Steve crashes Schmidt's bomber in the Arctic before the war ends ('After the war ends, Stark recovers the Tesseract...'), so Morita cannot fight with Steve until the war's end.

owner_calls.question: The stage sits on Spider-Man (1994)#10, but its first fact (the Kingpin sends the Shocker after Eddie and Spider-Man steps in) happens in #9 'The Alien Costume, Part 2'. Only Venom beating the Shocker and Rhino is #10. Should it stay on #10, or start at #9 with the Venom beating split into a #10 stage?
options: Move to #9 with text limited to the Shocker going after Eddie, and add a #10 stage where Eddie as Venom beats the Shocker
owner_calls.evidence: Part 2: Shocker, sent by the Kingpin to deal with Eddie and destroy his crash-site evidence, threatens him until Spider-Man intervenes. Part 3: Venom defeats Rhino and Shocker.
